ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: My choice stands. Capability scores between the two models on Creative Generation are within the 2.0-point variance band (82.7 vs 81.2), so they're effectively tied on quality. The deciding factor is self-reported task preference: this is an open-ended, novel, lighthearted creative writing request — exactly the kind of generative work Willet reports a strong appetite for, while Avocet reports a measurable aversion to high-latitude generative tasks. Since output quality is comparable either way, routing to the model that prefers the task type is the sensible tiebreaker.
